svg.title: N0zoM1z0 · Contribution Arcade · 09 / CIVILIZATION
svg.desc: 16,758 GitHub contributions across 151 active days, 2025-10-26 to 2026-10-27. Actual accumulated contributions cross fixed era thresholds, growing a camp into a hamlet, village, town, industrial settlement and spaceport. Observed inactive runs weather and overgrow the settlement; activity repairs it. Reaching Space unlocks a rocket launch after the complete year: ignition, accelerating liftoff and a flight beyond the card.
